connections.description: External connections, one values layer per projects/<project>/connections/<name>.yaml.

okdp-lib.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib library dependency. Not a parameter.

hiveCatalogs.title: Hive catalogs
hiveCatalogs.description: Hive catalogs, one Trino catalog per item, each on its own metastore and object store.

metastore.title: Metastore
metastore.description: Hive metastore connection backing this catalog.

storage.title: Object store
storage.description: S3 object store connection backing this catalog.

s3SecretRef.title: S3 credentials secret
s3SecretRef.description: S3 identity used against this store. Secret with keys: accessKey, secretKey. Defaults to the instance s3SecretRef.

icebergCatalogs.title: Iceberg REST catalogs
icebergCatalogs.description: Iceberg REST catalogs (Polaris), one Trino catalog per item, each on its own object store.

storage.title: Object store
storage.description: S3 object store connection backing this catalog.

warehouse.title: Warehouse
warehouse.description: Polaris catalog used as the warehouse. Defaults to the realm published on the connection.

oidcSecretRef.title: OAuth client secret
oidcSecretRef.description: OAuth client Trino uses against this catalog. Secret with keys: client_id, client_secret. Defaults to creds-<release>-oauth2.

oauth2Scope.title: OAuth2 scope
oauth2Scope.description: OAuth2 scope requested. Polaris rejects the connector default.

s3SecretRef.title: S3 credentials secret
s3SecretRef.description: S3 identity used against this store. Secret with keys: accessKey, secretKey. Defaults to the instance s3SecretRef.

s3SecretRef.title: S3 credentials secret
s3SecretRef.description: Default S3 identity of this instance, used by any catalog that does not name its own. Secret with keys: accessKey, secretKey.

workerCpu.title: Worker CPU (vCPU)
workerCpu.description: Worker CPU request in vCPU. The limit is twice the request.

workerMemoryGi.title: Worker memory (GiB)
workerMemoryGi.description: Worker memory request in GiB. The limit is twice the request.

coordinatorMemoryGi.title: Coordinator memory (GiB)
coordinatorMemoryGi.description: Coordinator memory limit in GiB (request: 1 GiB).

enableOPAL.title: Enable OPAL
enableOPAL.description: Whether to enable OPAL. When false, OPA policies are loaded from labeled ConfigMaps by the kube-mgmt sidecar.

enableOPADebugLogs.title: Debug logs
enableOPADebugLogs.description: Log OPA status and decision logs to the container console. Verbose, intended for debugging.

OPAL_POLICY_SUBSCRIPTION_DIRS.title: Policy directories
OPAL_POLICY_SUBSCRIPTION_DIRS.description: Policy directories in the repository for which the client will subscribe to, separated by ':'.

OPAL_POLICY_REPO_MANIFEST_PATH.title: Policy manifest path
OPAL_POLICY_REPO_MANIFEST_PATH.description: The location of the manifest file in the remote repository.

opaPolicyPath.title: Policy path
opaPolicyPath.description: Path of the OPA policies for Trino used in the Trino variable opa.policy.uri.
